# Project knowledge and tooling (area `project`)

Docs, licences, agent instructions, this kb registry and gate, and historical spikes.

Active decisions here. Run `tools/kb/run kb show <file>` for the ones governing one file, their tests and open work; never reword an owner decision (supersede it).

- **PROJ-500** (owner): Examples, copy and tests in tracked files use invented data only; nothing personal to the owner is committed. Personal parts live in local untracked files (kb/local/).
- **PROJ-501** (owner): The repo has no CHANGELOG.md. Release notes, if any, are a new decision.
- **PROJ-502** (owner): After a UI edit an agent may build and relaunch the development build and the playground; relaunching the installed FERB.app needs the owner's OK.
- **PROJ-503** (owner): FERB is licensed Apache-2.0 (LICENSE, pyproject.toml).
- **PROJ-504** (owner): THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md keeps the license attributions for bundled third-party code.
- **PROJ-505** (owner): When an older decision disagrees with code the owner has tested, the code stands: the decision is superseded by one that states what the code does. A decision the owner made after the code (e.g. MEM-35) is built instead.
- **PROJ-506** (owner): FERB targets macOS (FERB.app) and phone companions on iPhone and Android. There is no Windows port: the windows branch and its work were deleted on 2026-11-03, and no Windows code, tasks or decisions are kept. A Windows version again would be a new owner decision.
